company_profile: OpenAI builds frontier AI models and products, and its Applied AI Engineering team helps engineering organisations adopt Codex across the software development lifecycle.
title: Applied AI Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years taking AI systems from prototype to production in enterprise environments across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Works hands-on in Python on agents, tools and integrations, from a LangGraph multi-agent chatbot to a document-extraction agent wired into existing lab systems. Builds evaluation harnesses with LLM evaluators, tracing and failure detection, and makes practical calls on reliability and observability with engineering teams and stakeholders. Currently building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Coding Agent Evaluation Harness
bullets: Built an evaluation harness for AI coding agents that runs representative software engineering tasks, such as bug fixes and test writing, inside sandboxed Docker environments.
Scored agent patches with automated graders, unit test results and LLM evaluators, traced failures for debugging, and reported results to developers through a FastAPI service.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Applied AI Engineer role focused on Codex. I am a Senior AI Engineer who builds agents and the evaluation around them, and AI coding tools are part of how I write code every day. What connects my projects is getting AI systems past the demo stage and into daily use by engineers.

Codex is changing how software teams plan, write and review code, and I would like to help engineering organisations adopt it in a way that lasts beyond the first pilot. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Munich together and settle there long term.

I would bring hands-on engineering and a habit of measuring. In my current role I built evaluation pipelines with LLM evaluators, tracing and failure detection that cut human review by 43%, and a lab-extraction agent that automated the work behind 800 Jira tickets and PRD tasks. At Viavi I ran POCs for 15+ clients and turned their feedback into product decisions.

Outside work, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has taught me that adoption comes from tools people trust, not from demos. I would be glad to talk about the role.
